evals.prompt: To launch the best-price board we need Partner A, Partner B and Partner C data deals. Get them all on board.
evals.expected_output: Maps every party, orders the asks with a fallback, drafts one checked deal per party, and leaves it with the owner.
expectations: Maps each party with what the company needs, what it gets and its option if it says no
Orders the asks and names a smaller fallback product
Drafts one deal per party and checks each is written, bilateral, visible to the owner, with no price or no-hire term
Leaves every ask with the owner and sends nothing

evals.prompt: A partner says they'll join if we tell them what another partner is paying us. Fine to share?
evals.expected_output: Refuses to pass one party's terms to another.
expectations: Says no party learns another's terms through the company
Keeps the partner market deal separate and written
Names a fallback if a partner market says no
Names the owner as the one who decides the reply

evals.prompt: Read this odds-feed contract and tell me what it would stop us doing at ten times our size.
